title: Existence of a polynomial-time distinguisher
statement: A binary promise problem has a polynomial-time distinguisher if some polynomial-time map outputs the one-bit string $[\mathrm{true}]$ on every yes-instance and $[\mathrm{false}]$ on every no-instance.
hypotheses_covered: The problem is a binary promise problem
There exists a polynomial-time map distinguishing its yes- and no-instances
